name: kraken
languages: Understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can’t speak

actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: siege monster
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}  makes two  [[/item .mmTentacle000000]] attacks and uses  [[/item .mmFling000000000]], [[/item .mmLightningStrik]], or  [[/item .mmSwallow0000000]].

actions.name: tentacle
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. The target has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) from one of ten tentacles, and it has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: fling
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} throws a [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=E7YKnUIWsavrnNzK]] Grappled by it to a space it can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=E7YKnUIWsavrnNzK]] feet of itself [[lookup @range.special activity=E7YKnUIWsavrnNzK]]. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=E7YKnUIWsavrnNzK]], the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: lightning strike
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=v39JwGqgfaKiA4vc]], one [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=v39JwGqgfaKiA4vc]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=v39JwGqgfaKiA4vc]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: swallow
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=YorssyWMumAsvzx3]], [[lookup @target.affects.labels.statblock activity=YorssyWMumAsvzx3]] Grappled by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} (it can have up to four creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: [[/damage average activity=YorssyWMumAsvzx3]] damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is swallowed and no longer Grappled. A swallowed creature has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition, has &Reference[Total Cover] against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and takes [[/damage average activity=zrWNjO9mkbN28spL]] damage at the start of each of its turns. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save format=long activity=rGeGukkm2t2fXsoy]] at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} with the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

actions.name: toxic ink
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=Kquf9zADg0jtKBqw]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=Kquf9zADg0jtKBqw]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=Kquf9zADg0jtKBqw]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} while it is underwater. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] and &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] conditions until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} then moves up to its Speed. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
